transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

People at work are plotting against me and changing my routes on purpose, and no one believes me when I tell them it’s happening. They keep trying to tell me it's just computer glitches, but I know they are doing it secretly to make me look bad.
How long have you been noticing these beliefs that people at work are plotting against you—has it been less than a month, or longer than a month?
It's definitely been longer than a month, more like the last couple of months now. It started out as just a nagging suspicion, but lately it has completely taken over and I can't shake it at all.
Have you noticed any other unusual experiences, like hearing voices, seeing things others don’t, or feeling that your thoughts are being controlled or broadcast to others?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't there, and my thoughts are completely my own. It's just the actual, physical sabotaging of my routes at work that is happening.
Has this belief been the main problem, or have you also had major changes in your mood, sleep, energy, or daily functioning since it started?

Yes, it's much more than just the plotting. I've completely lost my energy and stopped caring about my choir, softball, and church, which used to be so important to me. Now, I just lie on the couch in my work uniform without the energy to cook or shower, and my husband is frustrated because I can barely give him more than one-word answers.
Over the past couple of months, have you been feeling sad, hopeless, or down most days, in addition to losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

I wouldn't say I feel sad or hopeless, it's more like I just feel completely empty and flat inside. I don't have the energy to feel anything at all, so I just lie on the couch in my uniform without showering or cooking. Even trying to talk to my husband feels like too much effort.

During these past couple of months, have you also had a persistent low mood or loss of pleasure most of the day nearly every day, or has it mainly been the fixed belief that people are plotting against you?

It's really both of those things happening at the same time. I've completely lost interest and pleasure in everything I used to enjoy, like my choir and softball, because it just takes too much effort to feel anything. But the belief that my coworkers are plotting against me and changing my routes has also been incredibly real and dominant over these last couple of months.
When the belief that your coworkers are plotting against you is not on your mind, do you still feel depressed or unable to enjoy things most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, even when I'm not thinking about what they're doing at work, I still feel completely drained and don't care about anything. I've stopped going to choir, softball, and church entirely, and I just lie on the couch because it takes too much effort to do or feel anything.
Did the suspicious belief about your coworkers start before the low mood and loss of interest, or did the depression and loss of interest begin first?

The loss of interest and pulling away from my activities actually started much earlier, building up over the past year since I took on that lead role. The realization that my coworkers are plotting and changing my routes is much more recent, only really taking over in the last couple of months.
Before the belief that your coworkers were plotting against you started, did you already have a clear period of depression or loss of interest lasting at least two weeks?

Yes, definitely. For most of the past year since I took on that lead role, I had already completely pulled away from my choir, softball, and church because I felt so drained. The thoughts about my coworkers plotting against me didn't start until much later, just a couple of months ago.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when the suspicious belief about your coworkers continued even after your depression and loss of interest had improved or gone away?

No, those feelings of being completely drained and unmotivated haven't improved or gone away at all. I'm still dealing with both the plotting at work and that total lack of energy every single day. Since those feelings haven't lifted, I can't really say what it would be like if they did.
Have you ever had a time when the belief that coworkers were plotting against you continued for at least 2 weeks even though your depression and loss of interest had clearly improved or gone away?

I'm not really sure about that because my lack of interest and motivation hasn't gone away or improved recently at all. Since those feelings are still constantly there, I haven't ever experienced them separating from each other like that.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the belief that your coworkers were plotting against you continued even though your low mood, loss of interest, and low energy had clearly improved or gone away?
I'm not really sure because I haven't noticed that happening at all. Right now, both the feeling that my coworkers are plotting against me and my complete lack of energy are still very much going on.

Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the belief that your coworkers were plotting against you continued even though your low mood, loss of interest, and low energy had clearly improved or gone away?
No, I haven't experienced that because my lack of energy and interest hasn't improved or gone away at all. Both the plotting and my feeling drained are still happening together every day.
